motion.title: Radic
motion.summary: The video introduces Radic, a context-aware ad creative platform designed to understand a specific brand and its target audience better than generic AI tools. It highlights the platform's "ThinkBox" capability, which fetches brand data and learns from six different sources at once—including audience personas, competitors, ad libraries, websites, forums, and the open web—to automatically generate tailored marketing assets in various aspect ratios and track cross-channel performance.

motion.title: GenPage
motion.summary: The video explains how traditional, generic cold outreach is failing and introduces GenPage as the solution. GenPage is a platform that allows users to instantly generate personalized landing pages, slide decks, and media for individual leads. By tailoring content and making outreach feel more human, the tool helps businesses achieve a higher reply rate and book more meetings.

motion.title: FYNITE OS
motion.summary: The video introduces FYNITE OS, an AI-powered platform designed to connect data across hundreds of business systems. It uses artificial intelligence to scan data, automatically discover and fix inefficiencies, and allows businesses to design and deploy autonomous, self-healing workflows. The primary promise is delivering measurable ROI in weeks rather than months.

about.name: UPANANDA
about.title: MOTION DESIGNER & VIDEO EDITOR
bio: I'm a Motion Designer and Video Editor specializing in high-end visual storytelling, advanced motion graphics, and cinematic editing. I create visually engaging content that blends creativity with strategy to help brands stand out.

My expertise includes SaaS motion design, AI filmmaking, AI-powered video editing and generation, UI motion design, and interactive motion experiences. I also have strong knowledge of sound design, branding, color grading, typography, and visual design principles.

With a deep understanding of consistent brand identity and brand color systems, I focus on creating polished, modern, and impactful visuals that not only look professional but also communicate clearly and effectively.
